_comment: Context window of each AugureAI model, kept by hand from Augure's own API page (Issue #112). Neither GET /v1/models nor the MCP list_models tool reports a window (measured 2026-11-27), so a model absent from 'models' is REFUSED with its reason, never accepted with a guessed window (R8). 'auto' is not entered: the page states no window for it.
